title: 12 Best Lima's Craft Beer & Bar Scene
description: Explore Lima's vibrant craft beer and bar scene for 2026. Discover top breweries, unique pubs, and hidden gems in Miraflores, Barranco, and beyond. Find your perfect pint!

places.name: Barranco Beer Company
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their 'La Hija del Audaz' IPA or a tasting flight to sample various styles. Pair it with their 'Tequeños' or 'Chorizo a la Cerveza'.

places.name: Cervecería Barbarian (Miraflores)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Order the '174 IPA' or their seasonal sour. Their burgers are also a huge hit and pair perfectly with any beer.

places.name: Nuevo Mundo Microcervecería (San Isidro)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their 'Cacao Porter' or 'Avena Pale Ale' for something unique. Their 'Lomo Saltado' is excellent for a hearty meal.

places.name: Juanito de Barranco
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic 'Butifarra' (ham sandwich) and a cold local lager, or a traditional Pisco Sour.

places.name: Oveja Negra (Miraflores)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Maracuyá Sour' ale is a refreshing standout, or try their seasonal experimental brew. The loaded fries are also highly recommended.

places.name: Old Craftsman Taproom (Miraflores)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the bartender for recommendations from their rotating taps. Their 'Alitas' (wings) are a popular snack.

places.name: Hops Craft Beer & Burger (Barranco)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their burgers paired with a local IPA. Their sweet potato fries are also a must-try.

places.name: Lúpulo Restobar (Miraflores)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Ají de Gallina Empanadas' are fantastic with any beer. Ask for their rotating special tap.

places.name: Bar La Calesa (San Isidro)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A perfectly made Pisco Sour or a classic gin and tonic. Their 'Tortilla Española' is also excellent.

places.name: Pardos Chicken (various locations)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A quarter or half 'Pollo a la Brasa' with fries and salad, paired with a cold Cusqueña lager.

places.name: Cala Restaurante & Lounge
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Pisco Sour or a signature cocktail from their extensive list. Their seafood appetizers are also exquisite.

places.name: Ayahuasca Restobar Lounge
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their Pisco-based cocktails – they are masters. The 'Causa de Pulpo' is also a popular appetizer.
